```
    indices = np.zeros((1000, 1000, 20), dtype=np.int64)
    dist = np.zeros((1000, 1000, 20), dtype=np.int64)
    return indices, dist

while True:
    indices = np.zeros((1000, 1000, 20), dtype=np.int64)
    dist = np.zeros((1000, 1000, 20), dtype=np.int64)
    test(indices, dist)
```
